title: Dinosaur Blood After 115 Million Years?! 🦖
description:
Scientists have discovered chemical traces of blood-related molecules inside a 115-million-year-old dinosaur fossil.

The discovery involves heme, a molecule associated with hemoglobin, and microscopic structures interpreted as possible fossilized red blood cells.

But is it really dinosaur blood?

The evidence is fascinating — and still debated.

Science is stranger than you think.

Sources:
- https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2614248123
- https://www.reuters.com/science/evidence-red-blood-cells-seen-dinosaur-fossil-brazil-2026-11-02/

Visuals are artistic and scientific reconstructions, not microscope footage.
